Venus moonwalked into Libra overnight.

Venus, moving retrograde, slipped into Libra overnight. The Moon in Aries trines Jupiter today and opposes Venus tonight. Swipe for Aries, Leo and Sagittarius, plus one question to journal on today.

Save this for tonight, or send it to your Fire friend. 🌙
